Calculates the gradient of the elevation, the steepest slope in each cell, in any direction, from the 3x3 window around the cell.

**Toolbox folder:** Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Geomorphology, Slope, Gradient<br>
**Authors:** Daniele Andreis, Antonello Andrea, Erica Ghesla, Cozzini Andrea, Franceschi Silvia, Pisoni Silvano, Rigon Riccardo<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Gradient`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file | m |  | The map of the elevation. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `Finite Differences` | The formula of the gradient: finite differences, from the four neighbours, or the methods of Horn and of Evans, from all the eight neighbours and less sensitive to the noise of the elevation. Allowed values: `Finite Differences`, `Horn`, `Evans`. |
| `doDegrees` | boolean |  | `false` | Write the gradient in degrees; if not set, as the tangent of the slope angle. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outSlope` | output file | m/m or ° | The map of the gradient. |

**References**

- Horn, B. K. P. (1981). Hill shading and the reflectance map. Proceedings of the IEEE, 69(1), 14-47.
- Evans, I. S. (1980). An integrated system of terrain analysis and slope mapping. Zeitschrift für Geomorphologie, Supplementband 36, 274-295.
